title: Unit 1 Consolidation
goal: Consolidate cleft sentences, emphatic word order, adverbial intensifiers, and contrastive focus.

items: Use cleft sentences with 'lo que' and 'fue ... quien / donde / cuando'.
Use stance adverbs with the right commas.
Put an adjective or a phrase first and the subject after the verb.
Correct and refine an idea with 'no ... sino' and 'sino que'.
I can use cleft sentences with 'lo que' and 'fue ... quien / donde / cuando'.
I can use stance adverbs with the right commas.
